'''Lilypo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Lulupo]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Gemmapo]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "A skirt made of beautiful flower petals is perfect for the most mesmerizing dance. Feeling a little spellbound? Perfectly understandable."

Lilypo is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A bipedal hippopotamus that wears a short pink skirt visible above each hind leg. Its body is brown with a lighter brown underside. Its ears are tied together with a pink hair tie. It also seems to be wearing pink lipstick and its eyes are squeezed shut.

Lilypo's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its pink skirt and hair tie to purple, and its body becomes reddish-brown instead of brown.

== Evolution Trial ==
Lilypo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Lilypo]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Dig 120 treasures in [[Treasure Hunt]] or use x7200 fertilizer in [[Cozy Farm]].
* Obtain 60 [[Card Album|cards]] from card packs.

== Trivia ==
* Lilypo and its evolutions were added to the game on 6/3/2026 alongside [[Cosmoram]] and [[Heliabloom]].
